question: Pandit Ravi Shankar was awarded India's highest civilian honour, the Bharat Ratna, in 1999. He played which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar:-**

 
 
• **He **played the **Sitar **which is a** stringed instrument** with a long neck and a gourd-shaped body.
 
• He was known for popularizing** Indian classical music** in the West and collaborated with many famous musicians including **George Harrison** of the Beatles.
 
• Pandit Ravi Shankar was also awarded several other prestigious awards including the **Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Grammy Awards.** 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bansuri:-**

 
 
• The bansuri is a bamboo flute that is a popular instrument in Indian classical music.
 
• It is a transverse flute, which means that it is held horizontally across the player's body.
 
• The bansuri is made from a single piece of bamboo, and it has seven holes, one on the back and six on the front.
 
 
 
• **Tabla:-**
 
 
• It is a pair of hand drums that is used in Indian classical music.
 
• It is a popular instrument in Hindustani classical music, but it is also used in other genres of Indian music, such as folk music and popular music.
 
 
 
• **Shehnai:-**
 
 
• It is a double-reed conical oboe from India.
 
• It is made of wood, with a metal or wooden flared bell at the other end.
 
• Its sound is thought to create and maintain a sense of auspiciousness and sanctity and, as a result, is widely used during marriages, processions and in temples although it is also played in concerts.
 
 
 
• The** Bharat Ratna** is India's highest civilian honor and is awarded for exceptional service in any field including **arts, literature, science, and public service. **
